jsonPatch.expression:
object.spec.containers.transformList(i, c,


  !c.?securityContext.?capabilities.hasValue() && !c.?securityContext.?privileged.orValue(false),
  has(c.securityContext)
    ? JSONPatch{op: "add", path: "/spec/containers/" + string(i) + "/securityContext/capabilities",
        value: Object.spec.containers.securityContext.capabilities{drop: ["ALL"]}}
    : JSONPatch{op: "add", path: "/spec/containers/" + string(i) + "/securityContext",
        value: Object.spec.containers.securityContext{
          capabilities: Object.spec.containers.securityContext.capabilities{drop: ["ALL"]}}}) +
(!has(object.spec.initContainers) ? [] : object.spec.initContainers.transformList(i, c,


  !c.?securityContext.?capabilities.hasValue() && !c.?securityContext.?privileged.orValue(false),
  has(c.securityContext)
    ? JSONPatch{op: "add", path: "/spec/initContainers/" + string(i) + "/securityContext/capabilities",
        value: Object.spec.initContainers.securityContext.capabilities{drop: ["ALL"]}}
    : JSONPatch{op: "add", path: "/spec/initContainers/" + string(i) + "/securityContext",
        value: Object.spec.initContainers.securityContext{
          capabilities: Object.spec.initContainers.securityContext.capabilities{drop: ["ALL"]}}}))
